name: pure-cytosynth-dante-bonus-mills-three-then-empowers
notes: Pure Cytosynth (172utOanGk): [Dante Bonus] On Enter mills the top three cards of the deck, then empowers X = water cards in the graveyard. Champion patched to Dante, Hemomancer with Spirit of Water in its lineage (unlocks EXALTED + WATER). Top four of the deck: Dungeon Guide, Spirit of Water (WATER), Fairy Whispers (the three milled), Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card); a second Spirit of Water is seeded in the graveyard, so empower X = 2 only if the milled water card is counted. Pre-fix the generated body milled with a loop of MZMove(myDeck-0) so only ONE card was milled (graveyard 2, deck 12, empower +1) -- the previous fixture pure-cytosynth-dante-bonus-empower pinned that.

rulesClauses: [Dante Bonus] On Enter: Put the top three cards of your deck into your graveyard. Then empower X, where X is the amount of water element cards in your graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated enterAbilities["172utOanGk:0"] milled with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro: graveyard 2, deck 12, empower +1). Overridden in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MillCards().
